name: Kawabata
source:
Spirit of a 1st year student of Togai Private High School who drowned in a river.

[spoiler]He was killed by yakuza during an attempt to stop a kidnapping. This once good-natured and heroic young man slowly began to transform into a malevolent spirit. However, thanks to Izui's intervention, he was able to return to his old self.

His ghost power is will-o'-the-wisp.[spoiler]
